items.text: Monument blockers now decay over 24 hours, are fire‑immune, and sync correctly across server and client.
Boat building stations can be deployed even when the ocean level is non‑zero or negative.
Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources pulling nearby objects.
Maintainable structures and pipe access points now spawn on flatter terrain, reducing false‑negative spawns.

HAB armour correctly forwards damage to its parent hot‑air balloon health pool.

Crystal AR entities now start with ammo, allowing immediate firing.
Gamepad cursor speed on UI sliders reduced, with fine‑control via left trigger, snapping, and exposed speed settings in options.

2026-08-27.summary:
### World & Structures
- Monument blockers now decay over 24 hours, are fire‑immune, and sync correctly across server and client.
- Boat building stations can be deployed even when the ocean level is non‑zero or negative.
- Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources pulling nearby objects.
- Maintainable structures and pipe access points now spawn on flatter terrain, reducing false‑negative spawns.
- Pipe and roadside decor placements now succeed far more often thanks to dithering and configurable retry attempts.
- HAB armour correctly forwards damage to its parent hot‑air balloon health pool.

### Combat & Tools
- Client‑side prediction disabled for firecrackers and survey charges to prevent desynchronisation.
- Crystal AR entities now start with ammo, allowing immediate firing.

### User Interface
- Gamepad cursor speed on UI sliders reduced, with fine‑control via left trigger, snapping, and exposed speed settings in options.

### Economy & Upkeep
- Code‑locked doors with two or fewer authorized users are excluded from door‑tax calculations, lowering upkeep costs for small player‑run hotels.

### Network & Performance
- Critter animal network update range reduced to lower bandwidth usage.

### Bug Fixes
- Skin viewer now correctly displays cubemap reflections on viewmodels even when offline
- Viewmodel lighting now matches sun direction, fixing overly bright or dark appearance
- Master key no longer gets stuck in its animation when left‑clicked, ensuring proper use
- Paintable dialogs (paintings, canvases, pumpkins, sculptures, neon signs) now respect the F1 menu: interactions stop and brush preview no longer hides the cursor
- General store UI grids now properly refresh on closure, preventing UI glitches and asset bundle reference leaks

items.text: Adjusted critter speed values, improved animation blending, and fixed critters hovering above ground.
Enabled AI select/move commands for multiple animals with offset handling and added related console variables.
Added Rust+ support to allow players to kick teammates or leave the team themselves.
Implemented decay for monument blockers with a configurable grace period and fixed a restart bug that restored blocker health.
Added a small oil rig blocker and made minor adjustments to large rig and launch site blockers.
Balanced additional blockers (mil tuns, silo, large oil) as part of the S2P update.
Reduced monument blocker HP to require 1 C4 or 5 satchels to destroy.
Fixed water pipes spawning at odd angles and ensured gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
Persisted timeSinceLastUsed for playerboats, fixing the missing decay issue on daily restart servers.
Prevented looting of clipping player bodies while mounted on submarines; players must exit to loot.
Blocked moving items into furnace output slots, fixing a four‑year‑old exploit.
Added early exit for fertilizer creation when chance fails, preventing zero‑amount loops.
Corrected the composter UI title from "Furnace" to "Composter" in the loot panel.
Fixed the compost loot panel to correctly predict cook time by checking compost‑specific item data.
Increased the heavy pot helmet crafting cost to 2 sheet metal and 8 high‑quality metal.
Fixed the erroneous "Can't be deployed on boats" message shown for badly placed deployments.
Fixed missing sprites and icons in the shop UI, ensuring item overlays load correctly.
Made shop tiles clickable by fixing bundle assignments and resource loading.
Corrected composting time for items that are both cookable and compostable, using the appropriate time per item.
Fixed composter filter to accept food from the new prefab/item filter setup.
Prevented items that produce no compost from being accepted into the composter.
Resolved a bug where empty magazines could drop twice when playing in third‑person view.
Added a 3‑second hold‑E requirement to equip HAB armor, preventing accidental equips, and introduced equip sound effects.
Fixed navmesh generation behind doors in certain rooms, restoring proper AI navigation in those areas.
Implemented client-side prediction for grenades, improving throw and drop accuracy for both grenade and thrown weapons.
Fixed armor damage detection by replacing mesh colliders with box colliders on HAB armor frames.
Adjusted Honey Bandage values: instant health reduced from 10 to 8, healing over time increased from 4 to 6, and cloth craft cost lowered from 8 to 4.
Increased composter smelt speed to match previous behavior when splitting stacks, making composting faster.
Made High‑Quality Metal (HQM) ore rarer by moving it to its own population and doubling respawn delays; added rare HQM collectable spawns.
Corrected scientist corpses to use the ragdoll layer, preventing them from blocking movement and projectile paths.
Ensured oil rig radiation restarts automatically after a server restart if a forced reset fails, keeping the event active.
Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.
Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.

- Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
